name: Curtsy Lunge
research: Front = left leg, right foot steps back and across. Front leg: ankle stays (0.13,-0.01,0.074); shin 10 deg forward -> knee (0.13,-0.09,0.52); front knee 85-95 deg so thigh runs back-up 15 deg -> hip L (0.12,0.35,0.63); pelvis joint = hip centre + (0,0.051,-0.003) = (0,0.398,0.631). Back leg: hip R (-0.11,0.35,0.63) to ankle R (0.10,0.80,0.14) = 0.70 m (<0.90 leg) -> ~77 deg knee bend, IK puts the knee near (0.02,0.36,0.20): joint 0.20 m up, kneecap ~0.15 m off the floor ('nearly touches'). Back foot rot X +30 = heel up on the ball (ball ~0.02 m above floor). Crossed x +0.10 = curtsy. Trunk 6 deg forward, chest up. Arms hang (elev 10, palms in). Sources: Boren 2011 PMC3201064 (transverse lunge 49/48% MVIC glut max/med), Prehab Guys (weight on front leg, knee not caving), Muyor 2020 PMC7112217. Camera yaw -60 (not -80) so the crossover reads. Facts and checks: research/curtsy_lunge.json.
